purpose: First-wave engineering correctness and connection-reuse cost, not a dual-HCA or inference performance claim

variants.R0: candidate binary with connection pooling disabled
variants.R1: same candidate binary with bounded striped connection pooling enabled; same per-request MR registration and byte layout

server: SKV_4, frozen baseline server, mlx5_1, port 1, GID 3
topology: one physical HCA at each endpoint, one configured RailRoute
order: alternate R0/R1 then R1/R0 by pair index
identity: reuse the exact seeded object per size and check descriptor, placement, generation and content hashes before/after each process
analysis_unit: paired process block; reads within a process are not independent replicates

gates.correctness: every read has exact length and verified content; unchanged identity; no silently discarded failures
gates.reuse: R1 creates one connection, reuses it for subsequent striped reads, returns active/retiring to zero
gates.benefit: report all paired block ratios and paired geometric mean with resampled paired interval; no numerical gain claimed until measured
gates.adoption: keep opt-in regardless of pilot speed; no default-on adoption without hardware fault campaign and sustained-load validation

recovery.first_wave: one synchronous retry wave only after every original task quiesces; preserve successful task ranges; same owner and frozen identity; absolute publication deadline
unit_gates: direct and packed preserve successful tasks
no retry before failed transfer returns safely
cancel/deadline/version changes leave caller buffer unchanged
retry route budget and concurrent-read bounds
recovery.provider_gate: requires a legal same-owner alternate path; the current one-HCA fixture does not prove dual-path recovery or late-WR recovery
recovery.claim_boundary: test result or reduced retry bytes does not imply end-to-end latency improvement
